title: Two server-side unit tests failing on main after S119 — solo auto-resolve + post-detonation bomb placement
summary: Two unit tests on origin/main (HEAD 8cc8a0e, post-S119) fail when running `npx vitest run tests/unit`. Both are S119/S117 regressions in the multiplayer server-side code that the sprint itself shipped. Net unit-test count: 2 failed / 1378 passed / 1380 total. CI on the merged PR #140 must have either skipped these files or the failures were masked — worth checking the CI run. The failures point at two distinct regressions: (1) ServerWorld auto-resolves rounds for solo sessions, but S119 FEAT-SERVER-ROUND-RESOLVE-001's invariant is that auto-resolve needs ≥2 players (the test name spells it out: 'solo session never auto-resolves (need ≥2 players)'); (2) ServerWorld.placeBomb refuses to spawn a new bomb on a cell where a previous bomb detonated + the blast already drained — the no-stack guard isn't clearing, breaking the obvious 'place again on the same cell after the bomb went off' flow. Test 2 has a passing companion test ('bomb survives a partial tick') immediately above it, so the bomb-fuse pipeline is mostly intact; just the cleanup-after-detonation half is wrong.
repro: From a fresh origin/main checkout (HEAD 8cc8a0e, post-S119 #140), run `npx vitest run tests/unit/node-world-server-map.test.ts tests/unit/node-world-server-recipe.test.ts`.

Observe Failure 1: `node-world-server-map.test.ts > ServerWorld round resolve + tally (S119) > solo session never auto-resolves (need ≥2 players)` — AssertionError: expected 1 to be +0. The test seems to count fired round-resolve events; one fired when zero are expected.

Observe Failure 2: `node-world-server-recipe.test.ts > ServerWorld.tick — bomb fuse (S117) > after detonation, the cell is free to receive a new bomb` — AssertionError: expected undefined to be defined, at line 218: `expect(world.placeBomb("alice", 3, 4)).toBeDefined()`.
The repro is the test body itself — see tests/unit/node-world-server-recipe.test.ts:212-219 and the solo-session test in node-world-server-map.test.ts.
expected: Both tests are part of the sprint's own acceptance coverage and should be green on the same commit that shipped them. After detonation + blast drain, `world.placeBomb` on the now-empty cell should succeed (return a bombId). For solo sessions, no auto round-resolve should fire (the S119 acceptance line: 'need ≥2 players').
actual: Failure 1: a solo ServerWorld auto-resolves a round once (count=1, expected 0) — the ≥2-players gate is missing or off-by-one. Failure 2: ServerWorld.placeBomb returns undefined after `world.tick(3.0)` + `drainBlastEvents()`, so the no-stack guard isn't being cleared when the bomb detonates. Both regressions are in shipped main and any downstream consumer reading the test suite as the source of truth will see them.

Fix outlines (best-effort, not investigated deeply):
  - Failure 1: gate auto round-resolve on `players.size >= 2` (or whatever the S119-introduced check is meant to be).
  - Failure 2: the bomb-fuse / blast-tile lifecycle needs to clear the placeBomb no-stack reservation for the cell. Likely the cell tracking dict isn't pruned when the bomb entity is removed at detonation time.
